description: the woman of the reference picture riding: a young woman seer with long wavy golden blond hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, a silver blindfold band over her eyes and a silver circlet, a long dark blue robe sprinkled with small silver stars and silver patterns at the hem, a golden eye symbol on the chest, a grey belt with brown leather pouches, a long dark blue starry cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, a calm young woman's face in clean profile, no staff and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the head to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same woman, her face, hair, headwear, armour or robes, cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not her standing pose and not the staff and the book in the hand
